user_stories.goal: be able to create an account
user_stories.original_text: As a user, I want to be able to create an account, which allows me to interact with the Smartbrew system.

user_stories.goal: be able to manage preconfigured beverages
user_stories.reason: order it without needing to modifying my beverage.
user_stories.original_text: As a user, I want to be able to manage preconfigured beverages so I can order it without needing to modifying my beverage.
As a user, I want to login so that I can access my account

user_stories.goal: be able to view beverage options
user_stories.reason: an oversight of what I can order and see how much it costs.
user_stories.original_text: As a user, I want to be able to view beverage options, giving me an oversight of what I can order and see how much it costs.

user_stories.goal: be able to inspect the nutrionial values of the beverages
user_stories.original_text: As a user, I want to be able to inspect the nutrionial values of the beverages
As a user, I want to place an order so that I can receive my chosen beverage.
As a user, I want to pay for my order so that the order can be completed.

user_stories.goal: be able to enter the admin mode
user_stories.original_text: As a technician, I want to be able to enter the admin mode, allowing me to maintain the system.

user_stories.goal: be able to register waste disposal
user_stories.reason: the machine to correctly know when it needs to send an alert to me.
user_stories.original_text: As a technician, I want to be able to register waste disposal, allowing the machine to correctly know when it needs to send an alert to me.

user_stories.goal: be able to monitor the machine
user_stories.reason: know when I need to maintain, making the machine fully functional at all times.
user_stories.original_text: As a technician, I want to be able to monitor the machine, allowing me to know when I need to maintain, making the machine fully functional at all times.

user_stories.goal: be able to register ingredients refill
user_stories.reason: the machine to correctly know when it needs more ingredients and if it is capable to brew a drink.
user_stories.original_text: As a technician, I want to be able to register ingredients refill, allowing the machine to correctly know when it needs more ingredients and if it is capable to brew a drink.

user_stories.reason: discover drinks that match my preferences.
user_stories.original_text: As a user, I want to receive AI based beverage recommendations so that I can discover drinks that match my preferences.

user_stories.goal: be able to receive a receipt for a completed order
user_stories.original_text: As a user, I want to be able to receive a receipt for a completed order so that I have proof of purchase.

requirements.description: Allows a consumer to create a personal account in the system.

Allows the user to login an interract with the system

requirements.outputs: Ingredient information and possbility to order

requirements.description: Inspect the nutrional values of the beverages

requirements.precondition: A valid and available beverage has been selected

requirements.description: Provides personalized beverage recommendations based on the consumer's preferences, previous choices, time of day, weather, and detected mood.

requirements.postcondition: A recommended beverage which the user can choose to order.

requirements.precondition: The payment has been successfully completed.
requirements.postcondition: A reciept generated by the system.

product_backlog.name: Create account
product_backlog.description: Allows a user to creat an account they later can log in to
product_backlog.how_to_demo: Enter random credentials, and then try to login

product_backlog.name: Login
product_backlog.description: Allows a user to login to interract with the system
product_backlog.how_to_demo: Enter false credentials and then credentials which belongs to a user, should succed

product_backlog.name: Managed saved beverages
product_backlog.description: Allows users to create and manage their recipies
product_backlog.how_to_demo: Login to the system, order a drink, change up the ingredients. And then select the option to save it as a saved beverage. Log out of the system and then login to see it as an aviaiable saved beverage, modify it further and end the demo by deleting it to prove the mechnism works.

product_backlog.name: View beverage options
product_backlog.description: A list of beverages represented on the screen
product_backlog.how_to_demo: Navigate to the beverage options panel

product_backlog.name: Inspect nutrional value
product_backlog.description: A list of nutrional values of the drinks
product_backlog.how_to_demo: Click on the nutrional value option for the beverage

product_backlog.name: Place order
product_backlog.description: Users should be able to place orders
product_backlog.how_to_demo: Login, click on a beverage and then try to place an order. While placing an order you should not be able to click on other parts of the screen. Log out and login to make sure that the order isn’t there.

product_backlog.name: Pay for an order
product_backlog.how_to_demo: After placing an order, try to pay for it. Make sure the payment service has received and processed the transaction.

product_backlog.name: Enter admin mode
product_backlog.description: Allows admins to login to the system’s maintenance mode
product_backlog.how_to_demo: Login to the admin mode, through the pin code or the nfc card. Navigate around and then log out, the next user to login should not be able to access it blindly

product_backlog.name: Register waste disposal
product_backlog.description: A counter used to make the system aware of its current waste levels
product_backlog.how_to_demo: Place a order and pay for it, make sure it goes through, Record the earlier counter value and the value after it. Then let a an admin reset the value back to its original value.

product_backlog.name: Monitor system
product_backlog.description: An adminpanel which will be used to track the machine’s health, and maintainance reasons
product_backlog.how_to_demo: Allow an technciian to go around and navigate through the system. Make sure the alert goes through by temporary decreasing the counter values .

product_backlog.name: Update ingredient level
product_backlog.description: A counter used to make the system aware of its current ingredient levels
product_backlog.how_to_demo: Place a order and pay for it, make sure it goes through, Record the earlier counter value and the value after it. Then let a an admin reset the value back to its original value.

product_backlog.name: Recommendation system
product_backlog.description: The system recommends users beverages based on earlier history and today’s needs
product_backlog.how_to_demo: Place multiple fake orders and then see how the recommendation ml algo changes. Test the mood camera and try to change the history by inserting false values. Use different facial expressions and verify that the recommendations change.

product_backlog.name: Reciept
product_backlog.how_to_demo: Pay for different orders and make sure you receive a receipt with the correct information.

Original spelling and grammar are preserved, including nutrionial, nutrional, nutrion, interract, possbility, Prevligie, reseted, monitrong, fileld, reciept, creat, recipies, succed, aviaiable, mechnism, technciian, maintainance, Managed saved beverages, and let a an admin.

Line wrapping and spacing are normalized; words broken across table lines are rejoined. Multi-digit requirement IDs printed on separate lines are combined. Story list numbers are stored in id; original_text preserves the story wording.
Continued table cells are joined across pages: requirement 4 (pages 1–2), backlog item 5 (pages 3–4), and backlog item 10 (pages 4–5).
Backlog IDs 2 and 3 are Login and Managed saved beverages respectively; stories and requirements use 2 for beverage management and 3 for login. Original ordering and IDs are preserved.
